items.title: Elon Musk’s Neuralink gets US FDA clearance to test its brain implant in ALS patients

items.summary: Neuralink has secured FDA approval for its pivotal clinical study of brain implant technology in ALS patients. This research aims to evaluate the implant's safety and effectiveness in enabling users to control digital devices through thought. The study will focus on enhancing independence in daily life for individuals with severe paralysis. Neuralink's previous studies involved over 30 participants who used the technology for various activities.

Filibeck had raised the slogan 'Vote Chor, Gaddi Chhod' during the Bharat Summit 2026. His statements in support of the Congress party led to criticism from the BJP. Filibeck emphasized the need for international support for democracy in India. Around 1,000 delegates from 70 countries participated in discussions about various global issues.

items.title: Why some people feel a sudden urge to jump when standing near heights
items.title_zh: 为什么有些人站在高处附近时会突然有想跳下去的冲动
items.summary: Experiencing intrusive thoughts about jumping while near heights is a common phenomenon known as the 'call of the void'. This phenomenon often occurs unexpectedly and can cause confusion amongst individuals standing at dangerous heights. Psychologists suggest that these thoughts may reflect heightened awareness of risk rather than a desire to commit suicide. Studies reveal connections between these thoughts and anxiety, depression, and stress levels.

Despite reserving a front-row seat for easier wheelchair access, he found himself in a less suitable middle-row seat instead. The airline's delayed communication regarding this alteration was considered insufficient, and Air Canada must process the payment within 45 days of the ruling.

items.summary: Researchers at the University of Sydney investigated better methods to trap invasive black rats in Australia. By employing 'nudge' marketing techniques, they aimed to entice rats into traps using phantom decoys. These decoys represent missed opportunities, leading rats to be more engaged with the traps. The study showed significant increases in the rats' willingness to enter traps when decoys were present.

items.title_zh: 在推动无人系统之际，国防部长视察陆军无人机测试部队
items.summary: Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul on Friday visited an Army mobilization unit operating drone pilot programs, the defense ministry said, as the military pushes to reshape its reserve forces into an unmanned systems-centered force amid a demographic change. Kang paid a visit to the 72nd Infantry Division, a reserve force mobilization unit north of Seoul, earlier in the day, to inspect its drone testing and meet with service members and reserve forces there, the ministry said in a release. The 72nd Infantry Division has been running a drone and robot company under its wing as part of an Army initiative to transform reserve force units into drone-centered ones. Speaking to the troops at the unit, Kang called on active-duty soldiers and reservists to grow together as "one warrior community armed with professional expertise and combat readiness," vowing to build a "strong military" that prevails against any threat. items.title: Korea to tighten visa checks on foreign entertainers to curb trafficking
items.title_zh: 韩国将加强对外国艺人的签证审查，以遏制人口贩运
items.summary: Korea plans to tighten visa screening and workplace inspections for foreign entertainers to prevent human trafficking, including sexual exploitation and forced labor. The Ministry of Gender Equality and Family convened an interagency policy coordination meeting on human trafficking prevention on Friday, focusing on strengthening protections for foreign nationals entering the country on E-6-2 entertainment visas. The visa allows foreign nationals to work as singers, musicians and other performers at hotels and entertainment establishments. However, some have been subjected to sexual exploitation and forced labor after entering the country under the pretext of pursuing entertainment careers. The ministry discussed ways to strengthen information sharing among relevant agencies during the performance approval and visa screening processes to identify potential trafficking risks before foreign entertainers enter Korea. items.title: [COVER STORY] Court affirms foreign residents' right to political speech, leaving lawmakers to define limits
items.title_zh: [封面故事] 法院确认外国居民享有政治言论权，由立法者来界定其限度
items.summary: The Constitutional Court’s landmark ruling on the Immigration Act affirms that foreign residents’ political speech is protected by the constitutional guarantee of freedom of expression, legal experts said Friday. In a 6-3 decision Thursday, the court found the law’s blanket ban on foreign residents’ political activities unconstitutional, 49 years after the ban was introduced. It said the ban violated the principle of proportionality by excessively restricting their freedom of expression. The National Assembly must now spell out which political activities foreign residents may engage in and when the state may restrict them. Experts say lawmakers should hear directly from foreign residents and clearly define any restrictions. “The decision confirms that foreigners’ political expression is also protected under freedom of expression, which is a fundamental human right,” said Kim Kwang-jae, an attorney at Shin & Kim who represented the petitioners. items.title: What US Apache squadron inactivation means for S. Korea
items.title_zh: 美国“阿帕奇”中队停用对韩国意味着什么
items.summary: U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) confirmed Thursday that an Apache helicopter squadron at Camp Humphreys was inactivated, saying the move did not affect the allies’ military readiness or ability to deter an attack. The U.S. Army still flies Apaches from South Korea, but USFK did not say in its response who now carries out the squadron’s former missions. The Pentagon referred questions about the 5-17 Air Cavalry Squadron to USFK. In a written response, the command said the move was part of a broader U.S. Army effort to modernize its aviation forces and reorganize units for future operations. It did not say whether the squadron’s helicopters and personnel had been reassigned within South Korea or moved out of the country. “This action does not change U.S. Forces Korea’s mission, posture or commitment to the defense of the Republic of Korea (ROK),” USFK said. “The ROK-U.S. Alliance remains strong, and there is no impact to combined readiness or deterrence.” The command said it continues to work with the U.S. Eighth Army to maintain forces on the peninsula capable of deterring and de

items.summary: The ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) was set to decide Friday whether to take disciplinary action against Rep. Choi Min-hee, a member of its Supreme Council, for her controversial remarks about President Lee Jae Myung. Choi recently came under fire for her remarks suggesting that Lee, when he was the party's leader, had opposed former President Yoon Suk Yeol's impeachment, and for referring to journalists as "a pack of hyenas." Choi's case was referred to the party's ethics committee after DPK leader Kim Min-seok ordered an internal inspection earlier this month. Choi has since acknowledged that she had been mistaken, saying Lee had consistently supported Yoon's impeachment since the martial law bid in December 2024. The disciplinary proceedings come amid a deepening factional rift between lawmakers aligned with Kim and those aligned with former party leader Jung Chung-rae. Rep. Lee Sung-yoon, another Supreme Council member closely aligned with Jung, questioned the fairness of the party's push to discipline Choi. items.title: Seoul turns to AI to spot falling concrete risks on bridges, overpasses
items.title_zh: 首尔借助人工智能来识别桥梁和高架桥上混凝土坠落的风险
items.summary: Seoul is turning to artificial intelligence (AI) to tackle a potentially deadly hazard on its bridges, developing a new inspection system that can detect concrete at risk of breaking loose without requiring workers to climb beneath structures. The Seoul Facilities Corporation said Thursday it had jointly developed an AI-powered diagnostic device with a private company to identify the risk of concrete spalling, in which pieces of concrete detach and fall from bridge structures. The technology was recently recognized as an outstanding case in the Ministry of the Interior and Safety's collection of successful public sector AI and advanced technology projects. Until now, inspections of bridge decks have largely relied on workers riding elevated inspection vehicles and striking concrete surfaces with hammers, then judging the condition of the structure by listening to the resulting sounds. items.summary: A public service hotline built to help Seoul residents navigate everything from transportation to welfare and taxes is attracting attention abroad, with governments looking to Korea’s capital for lessons in making administration more responsive. Seoul’s 120 Dasan Call Foundation said it had conducted 19 international exchanges between 2023 and October 2026, including 17 visits by foreign institutions and two cooperation agreements, sharing its experience with government agencies and public service organizations across several countries. Among its recent visitors were seven senior Tunisian government officials who toured the foundation on Nov. 12 as part of a training program under the Korea International Cooperation Agency’s project to upgrade Tunisia’s national civil petition system. During the visit, the foundation introduced its specialized consultation services, procedures for handling public grievances and efforts to improve citizen satisfaction, while explaining how data gathered through consultations can be analyzed and used to improve public policies. items.title: Suicide deaths fall 16.3 percent in September
items.title_zh: 9月份自杀死亡人数下降16.3%
items.summary: The number of suicide deaths fell 16.3 percent from a year earlier to 1,014 in September, while the figure for the first nine months of the year dropped 11.7 percent on-year to 9,591, data from the Office for Government Policy Coordination showed Friday. Of September's total, men accounted for 69 percent, or 701 deaths, while women accounted for 31 percent, or 313 deaths. Across all regions, the total number of suicide deaths through September dropped from the same period last year, except for the central administrative city of Sejong, which saw a 27.3 percent increase in such deaths from a year ago, the data showed. The southern island of Jeju saw the biggest drop of 24.6 percent in suicide deaths this year, followed by the central city of Daejeon at 21.4 percent, and the southeastern cities of Ulsan and Daegu at 20.9 percent and 16.4 percent, respectively. Such sharp declines follow a series of anti-suicide measures by the Lee Jae Myung administration. The Seoul Central District Court handed down a two-year prison sentence, suspended for three years, for former presidential chief of staff Kim Dae-ki after finding him guilty of abusing his power in connection with the case. items.summary: Korea is extending its digital customs network into Central America, with Guatemala launching an electronic clearance system developed through a five-year cooperation project designed to speed up trade and strengthen customs enforcement. The Korea Customs Service said Friday that Guatemala officially opened its upgraded electronic customs system, known as UNI-PASS, at the headquarters of its tax authority, the Superintendency of Tax Administration, in Guatemala City on Thursday (local time). The ceremony was attended by Kim Ki-dong, director-general for information and data policy at the Korea Customs Service, Korean Ambassador to Guatemala Kim Deuk-hwan and Guatemalan tax chief Werner Ovalle, along with officials from both countries. The project, launched in 2022 as part of Korea’s official development assistance program, involved 6.9 billion won ($4.8 million) in support over five years. items.title: Nepali national killed, several wounded in Houthi attack on Jazan refinery
items.title_zh: 胡塞武装袭击吉赞炼油厂，造成一名尼泊尔国民死亡，数人受伤
items.summary: RIYADH — A Houthi attack on a refinery in the southwestern city of Jazan, near the Yemeni border, on Thursday killed a Nepali worker and wounded several others, according to the Kingdom's Energy Ministry.The strike was the Houthis' latest attack against key Saudi facilities, a day ​after the group claimed attacks on Ras Tanura, Saudi Arabia's largest refinery ⁠and a major oil export hub.The attacks come amid an escalating Houthi campaign targeting Saudi airports, oil facilities and other infrastructure.The refinery was hit by a “hostile aerial projectile,” which sparked a fire and led to the suspension of some operations, the ministry said in a statement carried by the Saudi Press Agency. The fire was brought ​under control.Emergency and technical teams had responded to the incident and were assessing damage and checking the safety of facilities, it added.The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen said it had destroyed a ballistic missile ‌launch platform ⁠in the Yemeni port city of Hodeidah, which it said the Houthis had used in Thursday's attack on the refinery.The workers injured in the attack are of different nationalities and are being given the necessary medical care, the ministry said. It expressed sincere condolences to the family of the deceased.The coalition initially announced an attack had taken place on Thursday afternoon, warning the Houthis that targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure would be met with a firm military response.The Iran-backed Houthis, who are fighting against Yemen’s internationally recognized government, control Hodeidah port on Yemen's west coast.The attack comes the same day that two Italian workers were killed in an attack on a facility in Kuwait, which was blamed on Iran.The Houthis also attacked Jazan port on Wednesday, causing minor damage and no casualties, the coalition said.The militia attempted strikes the same day on Jeddah Islamic Port and the Kingdom’s western region.On Tuesday, a Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh’s King Abdullah Financial District injured 11 people, according to Saudi Civil Defense.

items.title: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns Iranian aggression on Kuwait
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯强烈谴责伊朗对科威特的侵略
items.summary: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed Saudi Arabia's condemnation and denunciation in the strongest terms of Iran's heinous aggression against Kuwait, which targeted a vital site, resulting in several deaths and injuries. In a statement, the ministry said: “The continued Iranian attacks lead to further tensions and instability. The Kingdom reiterates that these violations undermine international efforts aimed at restoring security and stability in the region.”Saudi Arabia held Iran responsible for the consequences of its continued brutal attacks. It demanded an immediate cessation of these violations while reaffirming its full solidarity with Kuwait in all measures it takes to safeguard its sovereignty.

items.title: King Salman and Crown Prince offer condolences to Egyptian president over Giza fire tragedy
items.title_zh: 萨勒曼国王和王储就吉萨火灾悲剧向埃及总统表示慰问
items.summary: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman have offered condolences to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi over the victims of the fire in Al-Warraq district in the Giza governorate.In separate cables sent to El-Sisi, the King and the Crown Prince expressed their deepest condolences and sincere sympathy to the president, the families of the deceased, and the people of Egypt. They prayed to God Almighty to bestow His abundant mercy and forgiveness upon the deceased, grant their families patience and solace, bless the injured with a speedy recovery, and protect the president and the people of Egypt from all harm. Thirty-one people have been killed, with another 21 injured, after a fuel truck overturned sparking a huge fire. The incident occurred when a truck was traveling from Cairo’s El-Marg district on the Warraq Ring Road near Giza, about 12 miles away from the famous Great Pyramid, on the evening of Wednesday.

items.title: Deputy foreign minister briefs ambassadors on Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia
items.title_zh: 外交部副部长向各国大使通报胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击情况
items.summary: RIYADH — Deputy Minister for Political Affairs at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Ambassador Dr. Saud Al-Sati met with ambassadors of countries accredited to Saudi Arabia at the ministry’s headquarters in Riyadh on Wednesday and Thursday. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, spokesman of the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, attended the meetings. **media[2800395]** The ambassadors were briefed on the latest attacks by the terrorist Houthi militia targeting civilians, civilian objects, and vital facilities in the Kingdom. The two officials said the attacks constitute a flagrant violation of international law and are terrorist acts that deliberately threaten the security, safety, and lives of civilians. They affirmed that the Kingdom will take the necessary measures to protect its security and the safety of its citizens and residents. They also stressed that the Kingdom will continue to support the Yemeni people and their legitimate government in confronting the militia’s attacks. The ambassadors reiterated their countries’ condemnation of the attacks. They expressed solidarity with the Kingdom in the measures it is taking to counter the attacks, and affirmed their support for its security and stability.

items.title: Energy Ministry: One killed, several injured in Jazan refinery attack
items.title_zh: 沙特能源部：吉赞炼油厂遇袭，造成1人死亡，数人受伤
items.summary: RIYADH — A Nepalese worker was killed and several others injured after an attack on Jazan oil refinery, an official source at the Ministry of Energy said, indicating preliminary information. A hostile aerial projectile struck the Jazan oil refinery in the Jazan region on Thursday, the source said. “The attack caused a fire, which has been put out, and temporarily halted some operations at the refinery. The injured are receiving medical care,” the source said.Emergency teams and specialized technical crews responded immediately. They are assessing, in coordination with the relevant authorities, the damage and checking the safety of the facilities, the source said while extending condolences to the family of the deceased and wishing the injured a speedy recovery.

items.title: SFDA, SWA agree to expand cooperation
items.title_zh: 沙特食品药品管理局（SFDA）与沙特水务管理局（SWA）同意扩大合作
items.summary: RIYADH — The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) and the Saudi Water Authority (SWA) have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to strengthen cooperation and integration in several areas of common interest.The memorandum was signed by CEO of SFDA Dr. Hisham Aljadhey and SWA President Eng. Abdullah Al-Abdulkarim. Areas of cooperation include conducting studies and research, leveraging the laboratories and capabilities available to both parties, and drafting, reviewing, and developing relevant legislation in accordance with their respective statutory mandates and authorities. Cooperation also extends to exchanging expertise and reviewing best practices. The MoU underscores both entities’ commitment to strengthening integration and joint efforts, contributing to greater operational efficiency, improved service quality, and enhanced oversight and compliance.

items.title: 77% of Saudi residents now within 800 meters of public spaces
items.title_zh: 77%的沙特居民现在距离公共场所不到800米
items.summary: RIYADH — The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing has announced that its 2027 targets include delivering 80,000 housing units and developed residential plots. Ahmed Al-Dhafiri, spokesperson of the ministry, said that efforts to improve the urban environment have enabled 77 percent of residents to access public spaces within an 800-meter radius. “These efforts include developing waterfronts in Jeddah, Al-Khobar, and Jazan, and providing attractive spaces for walking and recreational, sports, and social activities,” he said.Al-Dhafiri pointed out that 137 parks were completed by the end of September 2026, with work continuing on additional parks and urban improvement projects to provide accessible green spaces near residential neighborhoods. “Around 5.8 million trees were planted during 2025 and 2026 as part of efforts to expand green cover, improve the urban environment, and promote environmental sustainability,” he said. Al-Dhafiri stated that the ministry is continuing to upgrade municipal services and facilities to enhance housing stability for families, improve the quality of life, and increase the efficiency and attractiveness of cities. “The ministry is expanding the housing supply in cooperation with local and international real estate developers to diversify housing options for families and support balance and stability in the real estate market. The government's commitment to housing support and urban development reflects the priority given to the needs of families and residents in the national development process,” he said. Al-Dhafiri noted that the municipal and housing sector continues to build on its achievements, including enabling more than 25,000 families from the most vulnerable groups to secure adequate housing in 2026, while strengthening the private and nonprofit sectors' contributions to housing solutions and family stability. “Environmental sustainability initiatives have also included closing 115 unauthorized dumpsites and intensifying efforts to divert municipal waste and construction and demolition waste from landfills to reduce pollution and support recycling,” he said while stressing that improving the waste management system contributes to environmental protection and higher standards of public cleanliness across the Kingdom's cities. Al-Dhafiri said the 2027 targets also include raising the main roads quality index to 68.8 percent through intensified maintenance and rehabilitation works, reducing the visual pollution index to 73 in priority areas and major cities through field-based and smart monitoring, and increasing the readiness of municipal emergency and crisis centers to 80 percent through digital platforms. These measures aim to improve mobility efficiency, enhance the urban landscape, accelerate emergency response, and protect lives and property. The ministry spokesperson affirmed that the municipal and housing sector would continue working to deliver a tangible impact on residents' lives by providing a wider range of housing options, more accessible public spaces, safer and more efficient roads, and cities that are better prepared, more attractive, and more sustainable. He also highlighted the importance of strengthening cross-sector partnerships to achieve the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.

items.title: Saudi Arabia sounds alarm at UNSC over terrorist misuse of emerging technologies
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯在联合国安理会就恐怖分子滥用新兴技术问题发出警告
items.summary: NEW YORK — Saudi Arabia warns against the exploitation of emerging technologies by terrorist groups, including components that could be used to develop military capabilities. These remarks were made by Acting Chargé d'Affaires of the Saudi Permanent Mission to the UN in New York Faris Al-Otaibi during an open debate of the UN Security Council on conflict resolution amid rapid technological change. Al-Otaibi has affirmed that the use of artificial intelligence technologies must adhere to fundamental principles, foremost among them human responsibility. The Kingdom also stressed the importance of transparency in explaining the capabilities, limitations, and potential risks of AI systems, as well as the need to implement appropriate precautionary measures.He noted that the rapid development of military technologies necessitates compliance with international humanitarian law, the protection of civilians, and the preservation of human oversight and accountability.Al-Otaibi further called for stronger international cooperation, capacity building, and the exchange of expertise to enable countries to benefit from modern technologies while ensuring their safe and responsible use.

items.title: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns terrorist attack targeting Syrian security forces in Al-Hasakah
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯强烈谴责针对叙利亚安全部队的哈塞克恐怖袭击
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia strongly condemned and denounced the terrorist attack targeting a site belonging to the Syrian security forces in Al-Hasakah Governorate. In a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Thursday, the Kingdom stressed its categorical rejection of all forms of violence, terrorism and extremism. Saudi Arabia also affirmed its solidarity with the Syrian government and people in safeguarding the country’s security and safety. The Kingdom expressed its sincere condolences and sympathies to the families of the victims, as well as to the Syrian government and people.
